column4: Driver: By counting either ticks, the Host Driver assesses the re-tuning procedure's run timing. If this field is read as zero, the Host Driver should assess the re-tuning procedure's run timing by using other methods so that re-tuning procedures can be inserted during data transfers.

If this field is read as 1, the Host Controller supports the re-tuning mode 3 as defined in the SD Host Controller Simplified Specification Version 3.00. If this field is read as 0, the Host Driver should assume that the Host Controller does not support the re-tuning mode 3.

If this field is read as 1, the Host Controller supports the re-tuning mode 2 as defined in the SD Host Controller Simplified Specification Version 3.00. If this field is read as 0, the Host Driver should assume that the Host Controller does not support the re-tuning mode 2.

If this field is read as 1, the Host Controller requires the capability to execute the re-tuning timing by using the tuning procedure. If this field is read as 0, the Host Driver shall not execute the tuning procedure for SDR50. The Re-Tuning Request of the Tuning Mode 1 or the Re-Tuning Request of the Tuning Mode 2 is never set to 1 for SDR50.

If this field is read as 1, the Host Controller supports the DDR50 mode. If this field is read as 0, the Host Driver should assume that the Host Controller does not support the DDR50 mode. The Host Driver shall not issue the DDR50 mode command to the Host Controller.

If this field is read as 1, the Host Controller supports the SDR104 mode. If this field is read as 0, the Host Driver should assume that the Host Controller does not support the SDR104 mode. The Host Driver shall not issue the SDR104 mode command to the Host Controller.

If this field is read as 1, the Host Controller supports the SDR50 mode. If this field is read as 0, the Host Driver should assume that the Host Controller does not support the SDR50 mode. The Host Driver shall not issue the SDR50 mode command to the Host Controller.

If this field is read as 00b, the Host Controller supports the Removable Card Slot. If this field is read as 01b, the Host Controller supports the Embedded Slot for One Device. If this field is read as 10b, the Host Controller supports the Shared Bus Slot in this register. The Host Driver according to reading the Slot Type value, drives the Host Controller. The Host Driver reads an undefined value from this field, the Host Driver should assume that the Host Controller supports the Removable Card Slot.
